description: This file defines functionality for sharing content via deep links, including constructing URLs with messages and handling share payloads within an iOS application.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a custom URL with a message based on the shared content payload and optional instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string from the payload and instruction, respecting length limits.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a string and returns nil if the resulting string is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum number of characters.
